environment.description: Terraform provider state manager deployed as a sidecar container in a Kubernetes pod. The service is exposed via a ClusterIP service on port 8443 with no ingress controller. Any pod in the same namespace can reach the service directly. The container runs as root with the host filesystem mounted at /var/lib/terraform/state for persistence. No network policies are applied to the namespace. The container's filesystem includes symlinks created by init containers for shared module state references.
